title: t27b 0.2.0 · check the binary, compile a spec
desc: Recorded on the Railway t27c lab over ssh, in a clone of t27 at the tag t27b-v0.2.0: the release binary and its signed receipt are fetched from GitHub, the binary's sha256 equals the receipt's t27b_sha256, t27c corpus-receipt compare prints EQUIVALENT, a native x86_64 t27b built at the tag writes an AArch64 Mach-O object in milliseconds, and the release binary runs the spec's tests in its JIT under qemu-aarch64.
commands: for f in t27b-0.2.0-aarch64-linux t27b-0.2.0-corpus-receipt.json; do curl -sSLO https://github.com/gHashTag/t27/releases/download/t27b-v0.2.0/$f; done; ls -l t27b-0.2.0-*
t27c corpus-receipt compare t27b-0.2.0-corpus-receipt.json t27b-0.2.0-corpus-receipt.json; echo "exit=$?"
time t27b build specs/benchmarks/kernel_matmul.t27 -o k.o; file k.o
